Engineering would like to cover a few ground rules regarding control modules (CM’s).
1. CMs are NOT batteries. Please do not connect them to any devices other than the systems for which they are intended. Just ask Mr. Bell why we don’t have a microwave in the habitation area anymore.
2. CMs are powerful, complex, and EXPERIMENTAL – that means they tend to blow up under the wrong kind of stress. Again, see Mr. Bell.
3. CMs are proprietary technology. Under NO CIRCUMSTANCE should one be delivered to any location outside Pytheas.

Thanks,
Claudette Boyle
